notes: Attempt 2. Attempt 1 was rejected Critical for rendering TWO pointed patch pockets (which is the separate catalog option back-both-patch); the correction fixed it cleanly with no other regression. Attempt 2 shows exactly one pointed patch pocket on the wearer's left hip with the right hip completely bare, both hips in frame, so the asymmetry that defines the option is directly comparable inside a single picture. Handedness check: this is a rear view, so there is no mirror flip and the wearer's left hip is the left-hand side of the frame; the pocket is on the left-hand side. DRAWING-vs-LABEL DISCREPANCY, recorded deliberately: the tech-pack illustration (/images/blueprints/factory/5e26a3e5997d__3230__Patch_with_pointed.jpg) outlines a pointed patch pocket in pink on BOTH hips, but this option's label is 'Left Pointed Patch Pocket'. The catalog carries back-both-patch, 'Both Pointed Patch Pockets', as its own option with a different image file, which proves the factory drawing is a generic field illustration marking where this pocket family sits rather than a per-option count, and the pink outline is position notation rather than cloth colour. The label therefore governs the count and the drawing governs the shape. Everything else matches the drawing: pointed patch outline, patch-on-top construction with topstitched edge, belt loops, back darts running from the waistband toward the pocket, centre rise seam, no button/flap/zip, no annotation and no pink anywhere.
